findings.message: Assessment: the bank deviates from the approved blueprint. content-spec.md:1026-1027 (verified at G1, intake-2/evaluation.md:118) requires the 10 MCQs spread 4/3/3 and the 10 RRQs spread 3/4/3 across topics 8.1/8.2/8.3. The authored bank is MCQ 5/1/4 (unit-assessment.mdx:46-106: items 1-5 test 8.1 material, only item 6 tests 8.2, items 7-10 test 8.3) and RRQ 3/3/4 (unit-assessment.mdx:110-125: items 1-3 test 8.1, 4-6 test 8.2, 7-10 test 8.3). Topic 8.2 - a full third of the unit - carries one MCQ and three RRQs where the blueprint allots three and four. The ERQ structure (one per topic plus two integrative) does match. Repair: rebalance by replacing one 8.1-material MCQ and one 8.3-material MCQ with two 8.2-material MCQs, and re-topicing or replacing one 8.3 RRQ with an 8.2-material RRQ (e.g. an environment-parts or first-week-moves item), or amend the blueprint through the owner if the asymmetry is judged to justify a different split.

Assessment construction: 7 of the 10 MCQ keys are option (b) (unit-assessment.mdx:158-167; only items 6, 9 and 10 are c; none are a or d). A test-wise pupil picking (b) throughout scores 7/10. The pattern is course-wide (Unit 5: 7/10 b, Unit 6: 8/10, Unit 7: 9/10) and still unrepaired anywhere. Repair: shuffle option positions; no content change needed.

Authority framing (recurring class, third unit): unit-teacher-notes.mdx:87-90 states "The guide's practical component for this chapter is a group assignment: each trainee borrows the escalation ladder...", and sources/unit-08.md:20 calls it "the guide-named practical work behind the teacher notes". The guide's Practical Work list (1st 2026.txt:1182-1189) is course-generic (Hands-on Computer Exercises, Individual Assignments, Group Assignments, Presentations, Internet-Research tasks) with no chapter-specific ladder task. The ladder borrow is the unit's own - and good - instantiation of the generic group-assignment slot. Same advisory class as Units 5 and 7 round 1, both still unrepaired. Repair: attribute the ladder borrow to the unit, not the guide.

Sources registry accuracy: the seifert2009 Supports cell (sources/unit-08.md:14) describes the source's chapter rather than the taught sub-topics. For U8-5 it lists "the response repertoire: ignoring, nonverbal gestures, consequences, conflict resolution", but the taught U8-5 content is the five-step escalation ladder (documented practice whose mechanisms - nonverbal proximity, attention-as-reinforcement, consequences, the punishment-shame distinction - the chapter does carry); for U8-2 it lists "pacing", which the unit never teaches (the taught principles are prevention, routine, engagement, consistency). No learner-facing prose is misattributed; the registry row overstates the match. Repair: align the Supports cells with what each sub-topic actually teaches and the source actually carries.

Concept graph completeness: RRQ-03 (silence is not the goal) and RRQ-06 (why the relationship must exist before it is needed) are cited by no concept in concepts/unit-08.md:14-22. RRQ-03 belongs with CON:EFMP-301-8-1 alongside MCQ-05, which tests the same idea; RRQ-06 tests the relationships part of the environment, which has no concept of its own. The gate (scripts/check-concept-graph.mjs:147-153) only checks the forward direction, so this cannot fail it. Repair: add RRQ-03 to CON:EFMP-301-8-1 and add RRQ-06 to CON:EFMP-301-8-5 or a new relationships concept.

Teacher-notes key terms: unit-teacher-notes.mdx:80 says the unit's key terms "are banked where banked" and lists Classroom Management, Group Work and Active Learning - but Group Work and Active Learning never appear in the unit (grep across docs/semester-1/efmp-301/unit-08/*.mdx returns nothing), and the spec's key-terms row (content-spec.md:948-949) likewise lists Group Work, Active Learning, Self-Regulation and Positive Reinforcement, none of which the unit uses. Repair: correct the Language-and-access list to the terms the unit actually teaches (Classroom Management, positive learning environment, natural and logical consequences, escalation ladder), or teach the listed terms.

Coverage reinforcement locator: coverage/unit-08.md:21 maps U8-3's reinforcement to topic-03.mdx's "Managing individual behavior: responses and escalation" section, whose prose (topic-03.mdx:62-89) does not revisit the environment's five parts; the dignity and audience material there connects to the environment only implicitly. Repair: point the row at a section that actually revisits the parts (the teacher-notes sequencing table or topic-03's summary), or make the revisit explicit.

Alt-text completeness: fig-U8-1 carries an on-image tagline "not silence: a working class, visible in the books" (static/img/figures/efmp-301/unit-08/fig-U8-1.svg, small text at x=135 y=380-398) that appears in neither the manifest prompt nor the alt text (figures/unit-08.md:10; topic-01.mdx:38), so a screen-reader user misses the figure's misconception-correcting punchline. Repair: extend the alt text and the manifest prompt to include the tagline.
